text: My feeling is that it is possible to build and fly something that looks like a saucer,
just from a technical standpoint, but I do not believe that there is such a thing at this time.
I do not know of anything that would be considered in that category.
I'm very familiar with pretty much what's going on in the way of research and development,
and I know nothing that would be considered as flying saucers or flying saucer material.
You can make something that looks like a saucer fly if anybody would ever want to do it.
But I do not believe it would be possible with our best knowledge to have them make the speed and everything that everybody has been talking about.
